notes.title: 🗡️🐸🛹 Froggy's Battle 1.0.3 tiny update👩‍🔧
notes.notes:
Hey everyone 💌

Thanks again for the continuous support.
Steam decided to verify the game for Steam Deck, and there was a tiny thing I needed to fix to get the shiny green checkmark. Here is a small update for that, along with a small bug fix!

[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
- Running the game on SteamDeck should now always show you gamepad icons
- You cannot lose by getting hit by a projectile after beating the final boss anymore.

notes.title: 🗡️🐸🛹 Froggy's Battle 1.0.2 update 👩‍🔧
notes.notes:
1000+ players, 100% positive reviews, you frogs are unbelievable.
Thanks again for all your support 💖✨💌

Here is another small update with mostly bug fixes and one requested change: settings for how the turn keys work! Due to my limited skills and how the game is coded, I won't be able to do full control remapping, but I hope those settings helps people who had trouble with the default turning behavior!

[h3]New[/h3]
- [b]Turn Mode Settings[/b]: You can now choose between 4 different turn modes in the settings. Adaptative (default), Screen orientation, Trigonometric or Single Key! Full descriptions of those control modes in game.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- [b]"Too easy" achievement reworked[/b]: now requires you to finish hard mode with 5 or more hearts remaining. Come on frogs now its clearly doable!

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
- SKT now gives +20% move speed instead of +25%.

[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
- Fix music and sounds not starting for some rare players.
- Fix no upgrades appearing if you went beyond max stats.
- Fix Froggo the Bad's hitbox sometimes staying active and not in the right place one frame after landing.
- Fix life bar of Froggo the Truly Bad being stolen by random minion Froggo in hard mode.
- Fix CanonBoi that could sometimes still shoot while dying.
- Fix Typo on dash tip.

notes.title: 🗡️🐸🛹 Froggy's Battle 1.0.1 update 👩‍🔧
notes.notes:
Thank you so much everyone for your support!
Here is a small update with mostly quality of life and balancing changes 💖

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Sprite ordering: I reworked the layering system so that important things are not hidden behind other images. "WTF I didn't see that CanonBoi behind the boss" is not a valid excuse for your failed run anymore!
- You can now play with the gamepad stick.
- New tips! I hope you like them!
- Back hand equipments now state in their texts that they will attack behind Froggy
- Spiky hat has less hitstun

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
- You now have more base chance to find rare upgrades in hard mode. Should lead to less unwinable runs!
- Removed some CanonBois from wave 14 of hard mode (wth did I think when I put so much in here)
- JumpyBoi's hitbox starts to be active a bit later

[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
- Fix typo on spear
- Fix tiny bugs on controls that could make the game a bit laggy if you went back to main menu during a tutorial or when the upgrade pannel was opened
- Fix bug on upgrade that could lead to no selectable cards: not only this should not happen anymore, but if it does you can quit the upgrade screen and continue your run so it's not game breaking anymore
